title: OneNote for Android: Copilot chat pane with page summaries and questions
notes: claim 46: severity blocker on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
the verifier wrote "hold" but listed no blocker and fewer than three majors; the claims decide, so the page is not held
summary: The notice supports automatic availability of the pane, not automatic analysis of notes. The risk rationale says generative AI will read note content by default, which Microsoft has not stated; it should describe availability separately from the summaries and answers users request.

claims.claim: Copilot chat processes OneNote content the user already has permission to access for summaries and answers.
claims.quote: Copilot chat processes OneNote content that users already have access to in order to generate summaries and answer questions

claims.claim: The notice says the change alters how existing customer data is processed.
claims.quote: Does the change alter how existing customer data is processed, stored, or accessed?Yes. Copilot chat processes OneNote content that users already have access to

claims.claim: The change introduces generative AI interacting with customer note content.
claims.quote: This update introduces Copilot chat capabilities within OneNote Mobile, allowing generative AI to analyze note content that the user has permission to access.

claims.claim: Copilot only surfaces organisational data to which the user has at least view permissions.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot only surfaces organizational data to which individual users have at least view permissions.

claims.claim: Prompts from interactions with Copilot in OneNote are stored as part of the user's Copilot activity history.
claims.quote: When a user interacts with Microsoft Copilot (using apps such as Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OneNote, Loop, or Whiteboard), we store data about these interactions. The stored data includes the user's prompt and Copilot's response

claims.claim: Copilot responses are stored in the user's Copilot activity history.
claims.quote: We refer to the user's prompt and Copilot's response to that prompt as the "content of interactions" and the record of those interactions is the user's Copilot activity history.
